messages.author: 20e4ed233ffad79a
messages.subject: Re: What is the math behind y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")?
parts: Looks like this calls a method from the mgcv library. The formula y~s(x) means to fit a nonparametric smoothing function of x to the data y. The bs="cs" means to use the "cubic spline" basis for the space of functions. Googling "cubic spline" will get you lots of information about the theory.
